$comment: THE ENV VALUES BELOW ARE PLACEHOLDERS AND MUST STAY THAT WAY IN GIT. Claude Desktop reads
this file literally - it does not expand $VARS and it does not read a keychain - so the
only way a real token reaches the process is for something to write it into this file on
disk. That is why the committed copy holds REPLACE_WITH_* strings and why the real file
lives outside the repo: a launcher script should rewrite it from the OS keychain (macOS
Keychain, Windows DPAPI) at each Claude Desktop start. Never commit a real token here.
TAXCALC_MCP_BEARER_JWT is the credential forwarded to taxcalc-orders and llm-proxy.
TAXCALC_MCP_ORDERS_SVC_URL and TAXCALC_MCP_LLM_PROXY_URL select which services to reach.
LANGSMITH_API_KEY is required: taxcalc_ai.rag raises at import without it, so the RAG tool
is the one that fails without it - the other three work regardless.
